body:
Owner beta 0.1.8

Simplify the chat tabs and navigation headings. Keep saved connection activation available. Full workspace reads now return an exact raw-file source digest for guarded edits. Improve development-profile path selection and confirmed shutdown/recovery while preserving production isolation.

This unsigned, non-notarized macOS arm64 beta retains the existing Farol configuration and update channel. Local source, native fixture, and package checks do not establish live shared-Codex task acceptance. Python-backed helper dependency and unsigned distribution remain beta limitations.
